Credfeto.Package.Update 1.10.219.2911-main

Description:
  Scriptable update package tool

Usage:
  updatepackages [options]

Options:
  -p, --package-id <package-id> (REQUIRED)  Package Id to check for updates
  -f, --folder <folder> (REQUIRED)          Folder containing projects
  -c, --cache <cache>                       cache file
  -s, --source <source>                     Urls to additional NuGet feeds to load
  -x, --exclude <exclude>                   Package Ids to exclude from the update
  -?, -h, --help                            Show help and usage information
  --version                                 Show version information
